mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpStCmpyStatsList*/ SELECT A.YEAR , A.KEP_DEPT , E.TEXT1 AS KEP_DEPT_NM , C.GROUP_CODE , C.GROUP_NAME , COUNT(A.BUYER) AS CNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT YEAR, BUYER, KEP_DEPT FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C') A, ICOMCMPY B, BNTBUYERGROUP C, ICOMCOD2 E WHERE A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND B.CORP_CODE = C.CORP_CODE AND A.KEP_DEPT = E.CODE AND B.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND C.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND E.TYPE = 'C001' AND E.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND E.VALUE1 LIKE '9%' AND E.FLAG = 'Y' AND A.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') GROUP BY A.YEAR , A.KEP_DEPT , E.TEXT1 , C.GROUP_CODE , C.GROUP_NAME ORDER BY A.YEAR , C.GROUP_CODE , A.KEP_DEPT

/*selectMasterMpStCmpyStatsListSumGroup*/ SELECT A.YEAR , C.GROUP_CODE , C.GROUP_NAME , COUNT(A.BUYER) AS CNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT YEAR, BUYER, KEP_DEPT FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C') A, ICOMCMPY B, BNTBUYERGROUP C, ICOMCOD2 E WHERE A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND B.CORP_CODE = C.CORP_CODE AND A.KEP_DEPT = E.CODE AND B.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND C.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND E.TYPE = 'C001' AND E.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND E.VALUE1 LIKE '9%' AND E.FLAG = 'Y' AND A.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') GROUP BY A.YEAR , C.GROUP_CODE , C.GROUP_NAME

/*selectMasterMpStCmpyStatsListSumTeam*/ SELECT A.YEAR , A.KEP_DEPT , E.TEXT1 AS KEP_DEPT_NM , COUNT(A.BUYER) AS CNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT YEAR, BUYER, KEP_DEPT FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND STATUS = 'C') A, ICOMCMPY B, BNTBUYERGROUP C, ICOMCOD2 E WHERE A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND B.CORP_CODE = C.CORP_CODE AND A.KEP_DEPT = E.CODE AND B.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND C.USE_FLAG = 'Y' AND E.TYPE = 'C001' AND E.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND E.VALUE1 LIKE '9%' AND E.FLAG = 'Y' AND A.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') GROUP BY A.YEAR , A.KEP_DEPT , E.TEXT1
/*selectMasterMpStCmpyStatsListBNTBUYERGROUP*/ SELECT DISTINCT GROUP_CODE,GROUP_NAME FROM BNTBUYERGROUP WHERE USE_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY GROUP_CODE
/*selectMasterMpStCmpyStatsListICOMCOD2*/ SELECT DISTINCT CODE,TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND VALUE1 LIKE '9%'

/*selectMasterMpStCmpyStatsListBiz*/ SELECT A.BIZ_TYPE , A.CREDIT_STATUS , A.CNT FROM ( SELECT NVL(B.BIZ_TYPE, '*') AS BIZ_TYPE , A.CREDIT_STATUS , COUNT(A.COM_CODE) AS CNT FROM ICOMCMPY A, SUPLINFO2 B WHERE A.COM_CODE = B.SUPPLIER(+) AND A.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') GROUP BY B.BIZ_TYPE , A.CREDIT_STATUS ORDER BY B.BIZ_TYPE , A.CREDIT_STATUS ) A

/*selectMasterMpStCmpyStatsListBizCreditStatusSum*/ SELECT A.CREDIT_STATUS , A.CNT FROM ( SELECT A.CREDIT_STATUS , COUNT(A.COM_CODE) AS CNT FROM ICOMCMPY A, SUPLINFO2 B WHERE A.COM_CODE = B.SUPPLIER(+) AND A.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') GROUP BY A.CREDIT_STATUS ORDER BY A.CREDIT_STATUS ) A
/*selectMasterMpStCmpyStatsListBizM110*/ SELECT CODE,TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M110' AND FLAG = 'Y' union all SELECT '*','기타' AS TEXT1 FROM DUAL

/*selectMasterMpStCmpyStatsListBizCMpy*/ SELECT CREDIT_STATUS_CODE , DECODE(CREDIT_STATUS,'A','B-이상','B','등급미달','C','면제','N','미평가', '', '기타',CREDIT_STATUS) CREDIT_STATUS FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CREDIT_STATUS CREDIT_STATUS_CODE,CREDIT_STATUS FROM ICOMCMPY UNION ALL SELECT '*','기타' AS CREDIT_STATUS FROM DUAL ) ORDER BY DECODE(CREDIT_STATUS_CODE,'*',99,0),CREDIT_STATUS_CODE
/*selectMasterMpStSupplierStatsList*/ SELECT CREDIT_GRADE_CD, CREDIT_GRADE_NM, (A_CNT+B_CNT+C_CNT) AS TOT_CNT, A_CNT, B_CNT, C_CNT FROM V_BNTSUPPLIER_CNT
